Class Solver_yices2

java.lang.Object

org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_smt
org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_yices2
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISolver
public class Solver_yices2 extends Solver_smt implements ISolver
This class is an adapter that takes the SMT-LIB ASTs and translates them into Z3 commands

    protected boolean
    selfReportsImmediateExit()
    yices2 self-reports (get-info :error-behavior) as immediate-exit and its process does exit after some (not all) errors -- see AbstractSolver#sendCommand(ICommand, boolean), which uses this to pause briefly after any error response, giving a genuinely-exiting process time to finish dying before the next command's liveness check runs.
    IResponse
    start()
    Starts the solver; this is not an SMT-LIB command, but it is convenient in some implementations to separate the starting and initialization from the construction of the solver instance.

    • get_info

      public IResponse get_info(IExpr.IKeyword key)
      :status is the only real special case left here: yices2 has no native get-info support for it ((error "no info for :status")), so it's answered from the locally-tracked checkSatStatus instead. Everything else used to be hardcoded here too (:error-behavior, :all-statistics, :reason-unknown, :authors, :version, :name, and an "unsupported" catch-all for every other keyword) with stale values from a much older yices2 that apparently didn't implement get-info -- current yices2 answers all of those correctly itself (confirmed :error-behavior is actually "immediate-exit", not the hardcoded "continued-execution"; :all-statistics returns a real statistics dump, not "unsupported"), so they're now left to AbstractSolver's default (forward to the solver).
      Specified by:
      get_info in interface ISolver
      Overrides:
      get_info in class AbstractSolver
      Parameters:
      key - the info keyword
      Returns:
      the info value, or unsupported, or an SMT error response
      See Also:
      • ISolver.get_info(IExpr.IKeyword)
